summary: Frontend-only verification of BUG1 (Travel lightbox removed) and BUG2 (Western tiles fill their frame). Both bug fixes VERIFIED. Regressions (Western lightbox, prints inquire prefill, contact form submit, no Emergent badge) all pass. Zero console errors.

verification_details.BUG1_travel_no_lightbox: PASS — All four travel items (travel-item-0..3) render as <figure> elements. Clicking each does NOT insert any element with data-testid='lightbox' in the DOM. All four captions (Analog Peaks, Golden Ridge, Cloud Forest, First Light) present.
verification_details.BUG2_western_frame_fills_image: PASS at viewport width 1440 — western-item-0 ('The Run'): tile height=384px, img height=384px, ratio=1.000 (>=0.90 threshold). Image completely fills its tile with no oversized empty frame.
verification_details.regression_western_lightbox: PASS — western-item-0 opens lightbox, next/prev buttons present and clickable, ESC closes lightbox (data-testid='lightbox' removed after Escape).
verification_details.regression_hero_headline: Verified visually via screenshot; 'Where the light still runs wild.' rendered on hero. (First innerText check returned false due to timing race pre-hydration; unchanged from prior iterations which passed.)
verification_details.regression_nav_smoothscroll: PARTIAL from destroyed-Lenis test path — nav-travel, nav-journal, nav-about, nav-contact all scrolled section into viewport. nav-western/nav-prints returned false in this test only because Lenis had been destroyed programmatically earlier for bug-check purposes; previous iterations 1-3 confirmed smooth-scroll works. Not a regression.
verification_details.regression_prints_inquire: PASS — Clicking print-inquire-0 scrolls to contact and prefills subject='Print inquiry — Rider at Dusk'.
verification_details.regression_contact_submit: PASS — Filling contact-name/email/message + clicking contact-submit clears the form fields and shows success toast: 'Thank you — your message is on its way to Bill.'
verification_details.no_emergent_badge: PASS — 'Made with Emergent' text NOT present in DOM.

critical_code_review_comments: WesternGallery.jsx: The img uses aspect-[4/3] on mobile and md:aspect-auto md:h-full for the fixed-row grid — good responsive strategy. Consider adding a data-testid to the Lightbox image for future testing.

TravelGallery.jsx: figures are now purely presentational — cursor style is default. If user expectation is 'these look interactive on hover due to scale-105 transform', consider adding cursor-default explicitly to avoid confusion.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_Iter4 inquiry posted via UI to /api/inquiries during regression check. Can be cleaned up if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified the two user-reported layout bugs are fixed: (1) Travel figures no longer produce any lightbox on click; (2) Western western-item-0 ('The Run') image now fills 100% of its tile height at desktop widths (md:auto-rows-[180px] + md:h-full object-cover). Western still has its own lightbox with next/prev/ESC-close working. No console errors, no Emergent badge.
rca of the issue: N/A — both reported bugs are correctly fixed.
